e.not_json: :service did not answer in the form asked for.
e.unknown_provider: That AI service is not supported.
e.unreadable: The file :name could not be read — its type is not supported or it is damaged.
e.too_long: :name has more text than one AI request can read — split it into smaller files.
e.attachment_skipped: Attachment :name was not read (its type is not supported).
e.http_401: :service refused the API key — check the key in Settings → AI Services.
e.http_403: :service says this key may not use that model or feature.
e.http_404: :service does not know that model — check the model name.
e.http_429: :service limit reached (rate or credit) — try again later.
e.http_5xx: :service is busy or down — try again later.

test.odd: The service answered, but not as expected.

v.provider_taken: This service is already set up — edit it instead.
v.model: Write the model name as the service writes it, e.g. claude-opus-5-5.
v.api_key: Paste the API key from the service.
